s: Paul greets the Romans. The gospel is God's power for salvation. Humans who rejected God have fallen into sin.
God judges everyone impartially, Jew and Gentile alike.
All have sinned and fall short of God's glory, and all are justified freely by his grace through faith in Christ.
Abraham was justified by faith before he was circumcised.
Justified by faith, we have peace with God. Where sin abounded, grace abounded more.
In baptism we died with Christ to sin, to walk in newness of life.
The law shows sin, but I do the evil I do not want. Who will deliver me?
No condemnation for those in Christ. The Spirit makes us God's children. Nothing can separate us from the love of God.
Paul grieves for Israel. God's choice depends on his mercy.
Faith comes from hearing the word of Christ.
God has not rejected Israel. The Gentiles are grafted into the olive tree. O the depth of the riches of God.
Offer your bodies as a living sacrifice. Many members, one body in Christ. Overcome evil with good.
Respect authority. Love is the fulfilling of the law. Put on the Lord Jesus Christ.
Do not judge one another over food and holy days.
Bear with the weak. Paul's plans to visit Rome on the way to Spain.
Paul's greetings to many fellow workers.

5: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us. This is the proof of God's love.
